stage.note: IONOS Group SE IPO'd on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (Prime Standard) in February 2023; United Internet AG retains a 63.8% majority stake. Not a VC-funded startup, so pre-IPO 'funding rounds' are not applicable in the usual sense.

revenue.basis: Company press release: revenue of EUR 1,316.9 million for FY2025 (full company, not the Cloud/IaaS segment alone), converted to USD at approx. 1.08 USD/EUR.
revenue.quote: Revenue increased by 5.5% in 2025 to €1,316.9 million (2024: €1,248.1 million).

note: IONOS Group SE (brands: IONOS, STRATO, Fasthosts, Arsys, home.pl, InterNetX, Sedo, united-domains, world4you) is a publicly traded German web hosting / cloud company, majority-owned (63.8%) by United Internet AG; IPO'd on Frankfurt Stock Exchange (Prime Standard) in Feb 2023. Revenue and ownership figures are for the whole IONOS Group, not just the IONOS Cloud VM product covered by this card. In Sept 2025 the board decided to divest Sedo GmbH (AdTech segment); FY2025 revenue figures reflect this as a discontinued operation.
